انحرفوا (form VII)
# اِنْحَرَفُوا (inḥarafū) /in.ħa.ra.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْحَرَفَ (inḥarafa)
# اِنْحَرِفُوا (inḥarifū) /in.ħa.ri.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْحَرَفَ (inḥarafa)
